economics_q1.basis: q=1, one contract per action, TRACK B assumed fills only

1_matched_pair_economics.label: SHADOW. These pairs were never bought.

2_directional_residual.label: NOT marked. The residual's value is a settlement outcome, and L5's own corpus measures residual P&L as NEGATIVE (-$144,065 over 5,546 windows). Marking it at cost would flatter this line.

3_maker_rebate.rule: 0.0125 * C * p * (1 - p), credited at the point of trade
3_maker_rebate.status: ACCRUAL ONLY -- excluded from pre-rebate P&L and from strategy selection; income only once credited

4_liquidity_reward.why: program crypto_up_down_20260922 posts a $30 pool per daily_event across ~120 markets, but neither our eligibility nor our share of score is established, so it is counted at zero

5_taker_fees.why: every action is a maker join at the touch; nothing crosses

6_modelled_net.label: MODELLED. Not shadow-realized, not realized. The residual line is deliberately unmarked, so neither figure is a complete P&L.

capacity.why: capacity needs a fill assumption with evidence behind it. The only fill assumption available is Track B's volume-at-touch rule, which has none. No market-share figure is assumed.
